text: router C1 crashed (stopped)
expected: Its neighbours see their links go down and reroute within seconds. A crashed access router's own customer stays offline until it is started again. S1, the server every customer uses, hangs only off C1: every customer loses the service until C1 is started again (a single point of failure).

text: cable cut: C4–A3 (both ends see the link go down)
expected: Both routers see the link go down and withdraw its routes at once: customers routed over it should be back on another path within ~1-5 s.
